alignment.permissions: same internal phi only in O/I/P/G

cohort_analysis: O-only common inversions and all finite development positive-negative pair win/tie/loss transitions, frozen before candidate prediction inspection; full-population net AUC repair decisive
decision: If I has no positive mean primary contrast or does not improve over single, this frozen recipe does not demonstrate practical superiority; no rescue tuning or best-policy substitution. A positive development result permits a separately frozen independent-evidence protocol, not automatic acceptance.
primary_metric: source ROC AUC of served mean raw logits
primary_paired_contrast: I minus ordinary independently selected independent4
reason_for_lambda: One equal-weight own/served-pool hypothesis; no strength search and no observed-outcome choice
restriction_interpretation: A practical quality gain is distinct from proof that the internal restriction matters. That claim requires supportive fixed I-O, I-P and I-G comparisons; if P/G match I, the restriction has no demonstrated utility.
selection: unaltered full-development strict-first maximum each epoch; ordinary4 retains each member own-selected bank

statistical_plan.incomplete_family: do not silently average a reduced seed set or choose a different candidate
statistical_plan.multiple_outcome_claim: No confirmatory claim from this development family; all four policies and failed cells retained
statistical_plan.report: all seed values, mean paired difference, sample SD, exploratory df2 paired t95 interval
statistical_plan.unit: paired optimizer seed on one fixed scaffold split
